async def _connect(self, hostname, port, reconnect=False, password=None, encoding=pydle.protocol.DEFAULT_ENCODING, channels=[], tls=False, tls_verify=False, source_address=None):
        """ Connect to IRC server, optionally over TLS. """
        self.hostname = hostname
        self.port = port
        self.password = password
        self.encoding = encoding
        self.channels = channels
        self.tls = tls
        self.tls_verify = tls_verify
        self.source_address = source_address

        if self.tls:
            self.sock = ssl.wrap_socket(socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM),
                                       keyfile=self.keyfile,
                                       certfile=self.certfile,
                                       cert_reqs=ssl.CERT_REQUIRED if self.tls_verify else ssl.CERT_NONE,
                                       ca_certs=self.ca_certs,
                                       do_handshake_on_connect=True)
        else:
            self.sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)

        self.sock.settimeout(self.timeout)
        self.sock.connect((hostname, port))

        if self.source_address:
            self.sock.bind(self.source_address)

        self.sock.setblocking(0)

        if self.tls:
            self.sock = ssl.SSLSocket(self.sock,
                                     keyfile=self.keyfile,
                                     certfile=self.certfile,
                                     cert_reqs=ssl.CERT_REQUIRED if self.tls_verify else ssl.CERT_NONE,
                                     ca_certs=self.ca_certs,
                                     do_handshake_on_connect=False)

        self.sock.settimeout(self.timeout)

        if self.tls:
            self.sock.do_handshake()

        if self.password:
            self.send_raw('PASS {0}'.format(self.password))

        self.send_raw('NICK {0}'.format(self.nickname))
        self.send_raw('USER {0} {0} {0}
